entry_timing.explanation:
Entry timing is a weighted average of independent factors, each scored from -100 (poor moment) to +100 (good moment):

  RSI 1h = 84.3 -> -70 (weight 2.0) - Extremely overbought - a poor moment to add
  Bollinger position = 128% of band -> -100 (weight 1.2) - 0% = lower band, 100% = upper band
  distance to EMA20 = +10.16% -> -61 (weight 1.8) - Price 86,822.31 vs EMA20 78,814.12
  RSI daily = 74.2 -> -40 (weight 1.2) - Overbought - entries here chase the move
  MACD divergence (1d) = bearish -> -35 (weight 1.3) - strength 100/100
  resistance proximity = 8.9% away -> +25 (weight 1.0) - Room before the next resistance

  weighted sum / total weight (8.5) = -51.6 -> VERY_UNFAVORABLE
  Note: an imminent scheduled macro release is applied as a CAP on the score (weight 0 above), never averaged in - it can only worsen the moment.

Thresholds: >= +45 VERY_FAVORABLE, >= +15 FAVORABLE, -15..+15 WAIT, <= -15 UNFAVORABLE, <= -45 VERY_UNFAVORABLE.
